services.name: Bowfishing - Half Day
services.desc: Come fish with us! Duration 4.5 Hours About Trips are dependent on tide and weather conditions. After your booking is completed, our captain will reach out to you for confirmation. Adventure through the Nature Coast. The first half-hour of the trip will go over safety and equipment usage. Soon after we will be riding over oyster bars and rocks, going into the estuaries and creeks, through the heart of old Florida. We will encounter a wide variety of animals just a few feet from the boat throughout the trip such as dolphins working off the lights of the boat. Targeting fish for saltwater consist of Sheeps Head, Mullet, Black Drum, Flounder, Southern Sting Rays, Cow Nose Rays, Jack Crevalle,

services.name: Dolphin Tours
services.desc: Experience Evening Dolphin Tours with us! Duration 3 Hours About Nestled along the Nature Coast, Crystal River, Florida, boasts a spring-fed river that keeps the water temperature a constant 72°F throughout the year. This pristine environment nurtures an incredible diversity of flora and fauna. The unique shallow coastline, interwoven estuaries, and tranquil creeks create a sanctuary for wildlife enthusiasts, photographers, and nature lovers alike. Crystal River is renowned for hosting an exceptional variety of species, making it a mecca for those seeking to experience the wonders of nature up close. blurb: Guests are guided by Capt. Justin Dymond on adrenaline-pumping adventures combining hunting and fishing in the spring-fed rivers of Crystal River and Homosassa River. The offerings include family-friendly day or night bowfishing charters, evening dolphin tours, seasonal alligator hunts, and world-class inshore fishing charters. Novice anglers and hunters are welcome, with expert instruction and a patient guide.
